confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on scattered Spanish sources, not a dated Córdoba price survey: national cappuccino averages, a FACUA caña average for Córdoba of 1.46 EUR (survey year not confirmed), and menú del día snippets. Cocktail and wine are inferred from beer, not observed. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates and were not checked against listings. EUR was converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.15, not a verified one. The FX value came from search summaries, and the RBA page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Andalusian city. Drink and meal anchors are based on Spanish national averages and the Córdoba-specific caña figure. Lodging is judged against comparable mid-sized Spanish cities with tourism demand, with July peak-season pricing assumed.
